reason: I'd throw the free 30 receipts at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay yet. Where I actually lost money was mechanics and staff padding cash receipts and handwritten notes, and a bot that types up a fake number neatly doesn't catch that. I'd still be checking every receipt myself.
objection: It's a new little Telegram bot sitting in my staff group. I don't know who's behind it or if it'll still be running in a year, and reading a receipt is not the same as checking the mechanic really charged that much.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it actually flags a duplicate or a padded total from my scooter repairs that I missed myself, I'd pay the $19 straight away.
